connectorUiConfig.title: Cyble Vision IOC
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The **Cyble Vision IOC** CCF Data Connector ingests Indicators of Compromise (IPs, domains, URLs, email addresses and file hashes) from the Cyble Vision Threat Intelligence API into the native [ThreatIntelIndicators](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/reference/tables/threatintelindicators) table using the Codeless Connector Framework. Indicators are written with `SourceSystem == "CybleVisionIOC"`, so they participate in Microsoft Sentinel threat-intelligence matching (TI Map analytics rules), hunting and enrichment like any other threat-intelligence source.

sampleQueries.description: Get Sample of Cyble Vision IOCs
High-confidence Cyble Vision IOCs (risk score 80 and above)
sampleQueries.query:
{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| where SourceSystem == "CybleVisionIOC"
| where Confidence >= 80
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

dataTypes.name: {{graphQueriesTableName}}
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| where SourceSystem == "CybleVisionIOC"
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
 | where isnotempty(Time)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and Write permissions are required.

customs.name: Cyble Vision API token
customs.description: An API Token from Cyble Vision Platform with access to the Threat Intelligence IOC API is required.

instructionSteps.title: Step 1 - Generating API Token from Cyble Platform
instructionSteps.description:
Navigate to [Cyble Platform](https://cyble.ai/utilities/access-apis) and log in using your Cyble Vision credentials.

Once logged in, go to the left-hand panel and scroll down to **Utilities**. Click on **Access APIs**. On the top-right corner of the page, click the **+ (Add)** icon to generate a new API key. Provide an alias (a friendly name for your key) and click **Generate**. Copy the generated API token and store it securely.

instructionSteps.title: STEP 2 - Configure the Data Connector
instructionSteps.description:
Return to Microsoft Sentinel and open the **Cyble Vision IOC** data connector configuration page. Paste your Cyble API Token into the **API Token** field and set the polling interval.

Indicators are written to the native **ThreatIntelIndicators** table. Query them with:
`ThreatIntelIndicators | where SourceSystem == "CybleVisionIOC"`
